q: Can CCTS carbon credit certificates be banked for future years?
title: Banking CCTS certificates
short: Yes. Certificates a plant earns and still holds after a compliance year can be banked, then sold in the Indian Carbon Market or used for a later year's target. Under BEE's October 2026 draft trading procedure, certificates bought on an exchange cannot be resold, and voluntary buyers can only retire them.
audience: Obligated plants deciding whether to sell or hold certificates

ul: 2025 target rules: banked means certificates left with a plant after it completes compliance for the year; they may be banked as the detailed procedure provides.

Compliance procedure: remaining certificates may be banked for later compliance years, and banked certificates issued to the plant may be sold within the Indian Carbon Market or used for future compliance.

sections.h: Limits in the draft trading procedure (October 2026)
ul: Certificates bought through a power exchange cannot be resold under any circumstances.
Certificates bought by a non-obligated entity are for retirement only, with no resale or banking.
Issued certificates can be banked or sold up to their validity, set by the compliance procedure.

senseible: Senseible keeps a plant's fuel and electricity invoices as dated, fingerprinted monthly records, the activity data its monitoring plan and verifier work from.
